title.zh: Kintsu官网已恢复，但团队仍提醒暂勿连接钱包
title.en: Kintsu Website Restored, but Team Still Warns Users Not to Connect Wallets

current_state.zh:
基于 Monad 区块链的流动性质押协议 Kintsu 于 10 月 31 日表示，其官网 kintsu.xyz 已恢复正常并重新指向项目方自有基础设施。团队提醒用户，在 DNS 缓存完全刷新、官方发布安全确认之前，继续避免访问该网站并不要连接钱包，并称部分网络在未来一小时内仍可能访问到恶意网站。

最先披露此次正在进行的前端攻击的安全机构 Blockaid 建议用户暂时不要使用受影响的去中心化应用，并表示正在调查。Kintsu 的提醒说明，即便域名已恢复，风险也尚未完全解除，因为 DNS 传播延迟仍可能让部分用户访问到恶意版本。

据 Blockaid 称，受影响网站被植入恶意脚本，用户点击"Connect Wallet"（连接钱包）后可能被重定向至恶意的资产转移页面。Blockaid 表示该攻击与 StepDrainer 工具包有关，涉及 kintsu、flap 和 stonkbrokers 三个网站。
current_state.en:
Kintsu, a liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain, said on October 31 that its official website kintsu.xyz has been restored and again points to the project's own infrastructure. The team warned users to keep avoiding the site and not to connect wallets until DNS caches fully refresh and it issues an official security confirmation, noting that some networks may still reach the malicious site for up to an hour.

Security firm Blockaid, which flagged the ongoing front-end attack, advised users not to use the affected decentralized applications while it investigates. Kintsu's warning indicates the risk is not fully cleared even after the domain was restored, because DNS propagation delays can keep serving the malicious version.

According to Blockaid, malicious scripts were injected into the affected sites so that users who clicked "Connect Wallet" could be redirected to a page designed to move their assets. Blockaid said the attack was linked to the StepDrainer toolkit and involved three sites: kintsu, flap and stonkbrokers.

updates.background_zh: Kintsu 是 Monad 区块链上的流动性质押协议，其质押收益代币被用于各类 DeFi 集成场景。StepDrainer 被研究人员描述为在地下市场出售的"恶意软件即服务"式钱包窃取工具包，可从以太坊、BNB Chain、Arbitrum、Polygon 以及至少 17 条其他网络的钱包中转移资产。此类前端攻击通常借助 DNS 缓存投毒，通过注入虚假 DNS 记录，让访问者看到仿冒但高度逼真的合法网站副本。
updates.background_en: Kintsu is a liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain whose staking yield token is used across DeFi integrations. StepDrainer is described by researchers as a malware-as-a-service drainer kit sold in underground markets, capable of draining wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon and at least 17 other networks. Front-end attacks of this type typically rely on DNS cache poisoning, which injects false DNS records so visitors are served a fraudulent but convincing copy of a legitimate site.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事的传导渠道是面向用户的安全风险，而非协议偿付能力：风险主要集中于在被篡改的 Kintsu 前端上签署过交易的钱包，以及另外两个受影响去中心化应用的用户。由于事件涉及被广泛转售的窃取工具包，且针对的是 Monad 上 DeFi 协议的 DNS 层面攻击，它也会加剧市场对 DeFi 应用前端与域名安全的整体审视。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel here is user-facing security rather than protocol solvency: exposure is concentrated in wallets that approved transactions on the compromised Kintsu front end, plus users of the other two affected dApps. Because the incident involves a widely resold drainer kit and a DNS-level attack on a Monad-based DeFi protocol, it feeds into broader scrutiny of front-end and domain security across DeFi applications.
